hook: Your FASTag sticker has no battery inside.
title: Your FASTag sticker has no battery
description:
A FASTag is a passive RFID tag. The toll reader's radio waves power it for a moment, it replies with its ID, and the barrier lifts as you pass. No battery needed.

#Shorts #FASTag #Technology
comment_prompt: Do you use FASTag? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your FASTag sticker has no battery inside.
scenes.headline: NO BATTERY

scenes.narration: The toll reader sends out radio waves.
scenes.headline: RADIO WAVES

scenes.narration: Those waves power the tag for a moment.
scenes.headline: WAVES POWER IT

scenes.narration: The tag replies with its ID.
scenes.headline: TAG REPLIES

scenes.narration: The toll comes from your linked account.
scenes.headline: TOLL PAID

scenes.narration: The barrier lifts as you roll through.
scenes.headline: BARRIER LIFTS

scenes.narration: No battery, and it still pays your toll.
scenes.headline: NO BATTERY, STILL WORKS

scenes.narration: Tomorrow: a lake with no agreed border.
scenes.headline: TOMORROW
